verdict.rationale: Amplitude's core docs explicitly describe building funnels and segmenting users to 'answer why' (amplitude-docs-5, amplitude-docs-18), and its AI/MCP layer promises expert-level answers 'in seconds... No SQL, configuring dashboards, or waiting on the data team' (amplitude-docs-34), directly matching the self-serve, no-analyst-needed activation-drop-off use case. Community sentiment corroborates ease of use across non-technical roles (amplitude-comm-1), though some users report implementation difficulty and data-quality complaints (amplitude-comm-3) which is a caveat but not a concrete contradiction of the funnel/drop-off feature itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of funnel drop-off accuracy and founder-level self-serve success stories beyond docs claims.
